description: Last month at Beijing’s half marathon, a robot named Lightning beat the human world record by nearly seven minutes. It’s the latest in a string of AI-powered milestones that have got people wondering whether robots are about to enter our everyday lives, just as chatbots have. And the country leading the charge is China, where the government has pledged to invest more than £100bn in robotics over the next 20 years. To find out how robots are already entering the workforce, and what needs to happe…
classificationReason: Entire episode investigates robotics progress, workforce deployment, home robots, and human-like dexterity.
qualityReason: Substantive reporting plus an expert robotics professor interview.
